title: Meet Hip-Hop’s Buzziest New Acts in Billboard’s ‘Trending Up’ Series
summary: Meet the new wave of artists pushing it to the center of every hip-hop conversation
contentText:
Hip-Hop is hitting a different kind of stride right now in our latest installment of  Billboard News’ Trending Up , presented by Sonesta International Hotels, and we’re here to help you say you heard about them first.

Luh Tyler  and  Molly Santana  are making a splash in the hip-hop space with fresh new energy, and we want you to get to know them before everyone else catches on. If you’re feeling the vibes of Luh Tyler, make sure you catch him in Mesa, Arizona on August 23rd. The show will be just a short drive away from Sonesta Suites Scottsdale Gainey Ranch. The 164-all suite retreat features amenities like full kitchens, an outdoor swimming pool, hot tub, and fitness center.

Sonesta Suites Scottsdale Gainey Ranch

Separately, if you’re into the sounds of Molly Santana, you can catch her in Los Angeles, CA on August 27th. Pair the concert with a stay at the Sonesta Redondo Beach and Marina, where you’ll be able to enjoy ocean views, a heated swimming pool, and multiple dining options.

Courtesy: Sonesta Hotels

Sonesta Redondo Beach and Marina

We’re locked into Luh Tyler and Molly Santana sound and style, and they have our full attention, so see them captivate yours. Stay tuned for more artists to keep on your radar in upcoming installments of  Billboard News’ Trending Up , presented by Sonesta International Hotels.
